## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Never run Bandit on ledgerly without invoking it through ./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix `apply_credit` in `src/ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`: refunds are deducted before credit memos, leaving totals too high.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; never seed or write into `billing_v1` (superseded; frozen finance snapshot). Payroll: `payroll-2025-03`, version `3`; batch `batch-20250328-1842`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours: made stuck jobs invisible for hours.
- Tenacity retry refactor: stopped until next sprint.
- Direct Bandit execution: lacks required wrapper exclusions/baseline.

## Recent work
Added reusable test fixtures for invoices, organizations, customers, and time. Report fixtures passed 28/28; subscription tests passed 52 with 3 skipped; customer tests passed 31 with 2 skipped. `test_apply_credit_after_refund` still returns `90.00` instead of `87.50`. Payroll batch creation exited 0.
